name: Meta Huntsville

timeline.event: Building 2 roof starts to go on and its cooling installation is in progress.
We believe Building 1 and 2 are still being finished due to continued construction vehicles and unfinished land around the data center sites.
Color artifacts appear on small number of Building 1 fans. Continued presence of construction equipment and unfinished land around Building 2 suggests the final phase of construction.
We estimate that Building 1 is operational 30 days after the appearance of color artifacts on the fans.
We estimate Building 2 becomes operational due to being 120 days after final phases of construction, 9 months since roof and cooling were done, and similar Meta data centers construction timelines.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Meta Huntsville: current power 146 MW; owner Meta.

explain: Meta Huntsville is an operating AI data center in Toney, AL, owned by meta. Epoch AI estimates it draws 146 MW today and 198 MW when finished.
